title: Control flags X18a: policy.Parse decodes strictly, so a misspelled policy key fails the load
summary: policy.Parse uses plain json.Unmarshal (go/internal/policy/patch.go:9-21). Only cli_routing and quality use decodeStrict with DisallowUnknownFields (go/internal/policy/cli_routing.go:124-126, go/internal/policy/quality.go:23). A typo such as fleet.cuont is silently ignored. The knobs of X18c cannot move into the policy until the decode is strict. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §27 step 1; ADR-0156 rule 12.
fix: First list each unknown key of the tracked .evolve/policy.json and of the policy test fixtures, and remove or declare each. Then decode Policy with DisallowUnknownFields at every level. The error names the key path.
acceptance: RED first: TestPolicyParse_RefusesAnUnknownKey parses a policy with fleet.cuont, which passes today
The tracked .evolve/policy.json and every policy fixture parse with no error after the change
The error message names the full key path of the unknown key
Changed functions at 100% coverage; the policy package note and spec §27 updated
